Square 1024 x 1024 composition. Use a head-and-upper-shoulders crop of this source, including the FULL hairstyle and neck, with around 8 percent white margin above the highest hair. Perform background masking and black filling of the actual photographed person, NOT recreation of a generic silhouette.
notes: Selected second version. Rejected first version because it invented a protruding side-profile nose. Second version restores smooth cheek outline and black interior. Hair contours are model-edited approximations, not a pixel-exact mask.
